content.title: Capacity Planning & Guidance
content.content:
SnapLogic provides capacity planning guidance based on {{customer_name}}'s projected integration workload.

**Initial Sizing:**

- SnapLogic Professional Services will conduct a sizing workshop during the Foundation phase
- Input parameters: number of pipelines, execution frequency, data volumes, concurrency requirements
- Output: Recommended Ground Plex node count, CPU/memory per node, expected throughput

**Monitoring & Adjustment:**

- Real-time metrics via Monitor dashboard: pipeline execution duration, throughput, resource utilisation
- Historical trend analysis identifies capacity constraints before they impact production
- Predictive alerts when approaching CPU/memory limits or pipeline queue depth thresholds

**Scaling Recommendations:**

- Horizontal scaling: Add Ground Plex nodes when pipeline queue depth consistently exceeds threshold
- Vertical scaling: Increase CPU/memory per node when individual pipeline execution times degrade
- SnapLogic PS provides quarterly capacity review and scaling recommendations as part of managed services engagement
